questions.question: Three successive discounts of 20%, 20% and 30% are offered on an article. If the marked price of the article is Rs. 750, then what will be selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the article = Rs. 750

**Formula Used:**

SP = (1 – d1/100) x (1 – d2/100) x (1 – d3/100) x MP, where SP is the selling price and MP is the marked price.

and d1, d2, d3 are the three successive discounts.

**Calculation:**

SP of the article after getting three successive discounts of 20%, 20% and 30% = 750 × (80/100) × (80/100) × (70/100) = Rs. 336

**Hence, the correct answer is Rs. 336**

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 78 years. After five years, the ratio of their ages becomes 7 : 4. What is the present age (in years) of the father?
questions.solution:
Sum of the present ages of son and father is = 78 years

Sum of the ages of son and father after 5 years = 78 + 10 = 88

5 years after the ratio of father and son = 7x : 4x

According to the question

7x + 4x = 88

⇒ 11x = 88

⇒ x = 88/11

⇒ x = 8

5 years after the age of father = 7 × 8 = 56

Present age of father = 56 – 5 = 51

questions.question: Three positive numbers are in the proportion of 3 : 4 : 6. If the sum of their squares is 244, then what is the largest number?
questions.solution:
The ratio of three numbers are = 3x : 4x : 6x

According to the question

(3x)² + (4x)² + (6x)² = 244

⇒ 9x² + 16x² + 36x² = 244

⇒ 61x² = 244

⇒ x² = 244/61

⇒ x² = 4

⇒ x = √4

⇒ x = 2

The largest number is = 6 × 2 = 12

A man travels from P to Q at the speed of 60 km/h and travels from Q to P at the speed of 90 km/h. What is the average speed of the man for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Short trick:**

Average speed = (2 × 60 × 90)/(60 + 90) = 72 km/hr

**Detailed Solution:**

As we know,

Average speed = Total distance/total time

Let the distance between P and Q be x km, then

Average speed = 2x/[x/60 + x/90] = 2x/[(3x + 2x)/180] = (2x × 180)/5x = 72 km/hr

questions.question: A bag contains one rupee, 50 paise and 25 paise coins in the proportion 5 : 7 : 9. If the total amount in the bag is Rs. 430, then how many 25 paise coins are there?
questions.solution:
Ratio of coins of Rs. 1, 50 paise and 25 paise in the bag = 5 : 7 : 9

Ratio of value (price) of Rs. 1, 50 paise and 25 paise = 5/1 : 7/2 : 9/4 = 20 : 14 : 9

Ratio of value (price) of Rs. 1, 50 paise and 25 paise = 20x : 14x : 9x

According to the question

20x + 14x + 9x = 430

⇒ 43x = 430

⇒ x = 430/43

⇒ x = 10

Price of 25 paise in the bag = 9 × 10 = Rs. 90

Coins of 25 paise in the bag = 90 × 4 = 360

questions.question: A train crosses two platforms of length 1000 m and 600 m in 80 seconds and 60 seconds respectively. What is the length of the train?
questions.solution:
Let the length of the train be x m.

As we know,

Speed = (x + 1000)/80 ---(1)

Speed = (x + 600)/60 ---(2)

From equation (1) and equation (2)

(x + 1000)/80 = (x + 600)/60

⇒ 3 (x + 1000) = 4 (x + 600)

⇒ 3x + 3000 = 4x + 2400

⇒ 4x – 3x = 3000 – 2400

⇒ x = 600

Length of the train is 600 m.

questions.question: Anil can make 20 bags in 4 days and Manoj can make 10 bags in 5 days. How many bags both Anil and Manoj together can make in one day?
questions.solution:
Anil can make in 4 days = 20 bags

Anil can make in 1 days = 20/4 = 5 bags

Manoj can make in 5 days = 10 bags

Manoj can make in 1 days = 10/5 = 2 bags

Anil and Manoj together can make in 1 day = 5 + 2 = 7 bags

questions.question: Rs. 20000 is invested on compound interest (compounded half-yearly) at the rate of 20% per annum, then what will be the interest after two years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

​P = 2000

t = 2 years

r = 20%

**Concept used :**

Amount = P[1 + (R/100)]T

When compounded half-yearly,

T = 2 × T 

R = R/2

CI = A - P

**Calculation:**

If interest compounded half-yearly, then

T= 2 × 2 = 4

R = 20/2 = 10%

A = 20000 × (11/10) × (11/10) × (11/10) × (11/10)

⇒ A = 29282

CI = 29282 – 20000

⇒ CI = Rs. 9282

**∴ CI is Rs 9282.**

questions.question: Pipe V1 can fill an empty tank in 8 hours. Pipe V2 can fill the same tank in 16 hours. Pipe V3 can empty the same, completely filled, tank in 12 hours. If three pipes are opened simultaneously, then in how much time will the tank get completely filled?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe V1 can fill an empty tank in 8 hours.

Pipe V2 can fill the same tank in 16 hours.

Pipe V3 can empty the same completely filled tank in 12 hours.

Three pipes are opened simultaneously.

Formula used:

For LCM method,

If a pipe fills a tank in 'a' hours and an another fills the same tank in 'b' hours and a third one empties the full tank in 'c' hours and all of them are opened together, then

Total work = LCM of the times taken by three different pipes = LCM of (a, b, c)

Efficiency of first pipe = LCM of (a, b, c)/a

Efficiency of second pipe = LCM of (a, b, c)/b

Efficiency of third pipe = LCM of (a, b, c)/c

Combined efficiency of them = (+ efficiency of 1st pipe) + (+ efficiency of 2nd pipe) + (- efficiency of 3rd pipe)

[(+ve) sign for the efficiency of the pipe which fills the tank and (-ve) sign for the efficiency of the pipe which empties the tank.]

Time taken to fill the tank = Total work/The combined efficiency of the pipes.

For Alternate method,

If a pipe fills a tank in 'a' hours and an another fills the same tank in 'b' hours and a third one empties the full tank in 'c' hours and all of them are opened together, the net part filled in 1 hour = 1/a + 1/b - 1/c

∴ Time taken to fill the tank = 1/(1/a + 1/b - 1/c) = abc/(bc + ac - ab) hours

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aea245b2b7472a0ca677825d546513b76d745cb40de2410b9b49ca9fbc43a81.png] 

In fig, LCM of (8, 16, 12) = 48 = Total work

Efficiency of V1 = 48/8 = 6

Efficiency of V2 = 48/16 = 3

Efficiency of V3 = 48/12 = 4

Combined efficiency = (+ 6) + (+ 3) + (- 4) = 5

**∴ If all three pipes open simultaneously, then the tank filled in = 48/5 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

V1 fills in 8 hours

V2 fills in 16 hours

V3 empties in 12 hours

So time taken to fill the tank = 1/(1/a + 1/b - 1/c) = 1/(1/8 + 1/16 - 1/12) = 1/(5/48) = 48/5 hours

**∴ Time taken to fill the tank is 48/5 hours. **

questions.question: What is the average of the first 15 even numbers starting from 2?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick- 1**

Average of first n even number = (n + 1)

Average of first 15 even numbers = 15 + 1 = 16

**Short Trick- 2**

As we know,

Average of any AP median of that series.

Median of series = [(15 + 1)/2]th = 8th term

So, the 8th term of series is 16.

**Detailed Solution :**

As we know,

Sum of first n even numbers = n (n + 1)

Sum of first 15 even numbers = 15 × 16 = 240

Average of first 15 even numbers = 240/15 = 16.

questions.question: 30 kg of rice costing Rs. 50 per kg is mixed with 20 kg of rice costing Rs. 60 per kg. What is the average cost of the mixture per kg?
questions.solution:
Cost of 30 kg rice costing Rs. 50 per kg = 50 × 30 = Rs. 1500

Cost of 20 kg rice costing Rs. 60 per kg = 60 × 20 = Rs. 1200

Total cost of 50 kg mixed rice = 1500 + 1200 = Rs. 2700

Cost of 1 kg mixed rice = 2700/50 = Rs. 54

questions.question: The profit earned on an article is 25% when it is calculated on the cost price. If the profit is calculated on the selling price, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit is 25% when calculated on CP

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP – CP,

Profit % when calculated on CP,

⇒ Profit /CP × 100

Profit % when calculated on SP,

⇒ Profit /SP × 100,

Where, 

CP is cost price,

SP is selling price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be Rs. 100

Profit % when calculated on CP,

⇒ 25 = Profit/100 × 100

⇒ 25 = Profit

Profit = SP – CP 

⇒ SP = 100 + 25

⇒ SP = Rs. 125

Now Profit is calculated on SP,

⇒ Profit % = (125 – 100)/125 × 100

⇒ Profit % = 25/125 × 100

⇒ Profit % = 20%

**∴ Profit % when calculated on CP is 20%. **

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 800 invested on simple interest becomes Rs. 1200 in 8 years. What will be simple interest for 6 years on the sum at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

SI for 8 years = 1200 – 800 = 400

SI for 6 years = 400 × (6/8) = 300

**Detailed Method:**

P = 800, A = 1200 and t = 8 years

⇒ SI = 1200 – 800 = 400

As we know,

SI = Prt/100

400 = (800 × r × 8)/100

⇒ r = (400 × 100)/(800 × 8)

⇒ r = 25/4 %

Again,

If time = 6 years, then

SI = (800 × 25 × 6)/(100 × 4)

⇒ SI = 300

questions.question: The volume of a cube is 216 cm³. What is the area of one face of the cube?

The volume of cube = a³

a³ = 216

⇒ a = √216

questions.question: What is the difference in the number of refrigerators supplied to the hotel by companies C1 and C5 if the total number of refrigerators is 3700?
questions.solution:
The difference in percentage of refrigerators supplied to the hotel by companies C1 and C5 is = 26% - 21% = 5%

As we know,

When 5 is multiplied by any number the unit digit will be 0 or 5. So, 185 is the correct option.

If total number of refrigerator is 3700, then

The difference in percentage of refrigerators supplied to the hotel by companies C1 and C5 is = 3700 × [(26 - 21)/100] = 185

**∴ The required difference is 185.**
